examples.pie: kʷíd ǵénh₁tri h₁énos upér? só n̥bʰrós móḱs h₂wérseti. h₂ówins dṓm h₁n̥dó wédʰe. h₁íh₂es n̥bʰrṓd dedwiyḗr? h₁ésmōd ne dedwiyḗr h₂yuHn̥ḱéh₂es de studént. nu h₁íh₂n̥s wédʰoh₂.
examples.en: Mother, what is that yonder above? That is a rain-cloud; soon it will rain. Lead the sheep into the house! Are they afraid of the rain? They are not afraid of it, but the young ones get cold. I am leading them now!

examples.pie: kʷís pérkʷum h₁ḗdti h₁résos-kʷe dedwóye? só dʰegʷʰrós h₁ésti.
examples.en: What eats the oak and is afraid of the liquid? It is the burning.

examples.pie: Hyowdʰéyet kóryos h₁léwdʰim tóy-kʷe dedwiyḗr.
examples.en: War stirred the people, and they were afraid.

examples.pie: nu dʰéh₁ses ne dedwiyḗr tóy-kʷe gʷegʷmḗr.
examples.en: Now the gods are not afraid, and they are standing steady.

pie-lex-demeti.gloss: to build; to arrange, to put together

root.gloss: to build (up); to arrange, to put together

examples.pie: tétḱō wiḱpóteyey sédos démet. h₁íd stoh₂éyet. sédos méǵh₂ h₁ést. wéyḱt wiḱpótis h₁íd h₁ésmi-kʷe sédt.
examples.en: The carpenter built a dwelling for the lord. He set it up. The dwelling was great. The lord went into it and sat down in it.

examples.pie: wĺ̥kʷos dṓm démet. méǵh₂ih₂m dʰwórm̥ dʰédʰeh₁t. nu kóslosyo gʰórdʰom dʰéh₁mn̥ péri démet. nu wéwket. dyḗws ḱóm dṓm ph₂syéh₁t.
examples.en: Wolf built a house. He made the door big. Then he built a hazel fence around the house. Then he said: "May Sky protect this house!"

examples.pie: dṓm démete dṓm h₂réydʰete. h₁wésewes bʰréh₂teres dukté. nu dṓm stestóh₂e h₂éHsh₂-kʷe dʰégʷʰeti. bʰréh₂teres twóm misdʰóm h₁áydʰwe.
examples.en: Build the house, build it, put the house in order! Good brothers, pull! The house stands, and the hearth burns. Brothers, take your wage!

examples.pie: gʷémt nókʷts. gʰóstipotey h₁wésum swépnom h₁áyih₁th₂e. dyḗws ḱód dʰéh₁mn̥ h₂léksoyh₁t.
examples.en: Night has come. Master, may you take good sleep! May Sky protect this house.

examples.pie: dʰéh₁mn̥ bʰeydʰóm h₁ést tód-kʷe ǵn̥néh₃t.
examples.en: The ordinance was faithful, and he knew it.

examples.pie: h₂éǵr̥yos h₁ést dʰéh₁mn̥-kʷe ǵn̥néh₃t.
examples.en: He was of the field, and he knew the ordinance.

examples.pie: ǵʰeh₁ros súHs ǵʰórtoy légʰyet.
examples.en: The forsaken pig was lying in the enclosure.

examples.pie: nu pérkʷunos h₁ógʷʰim h₂én gʷʰént. wĺ̥kʷe h₂éǵrōd litdʰí h₂ówins mē gʷm̥yés. nu ǵʰoysós twé gʷʰn̥yéh₁t gʷéru twé gʷʰn̥yéh₁t.
examples.en: Now Perkwunos slew the serpent there. Wolf, go away from the field, do not come to the sheep! May the javelin strike you, may the spear strike you.

examples.pie: dʰh₂bʰrós gʷéru tḗtḱt. h₁ésmey ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ wl̥kʷogʷʰonóm dʰéh₁t. gʷéru wĺ̥kʷom gʷʰént. h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm bʰúHt. h₁ést méǵh₂ ḱléwos h₁ésmey.
examples.en: The smith made a spear. He set a famous name upon it: Wolf-striker. The spear killed a wolf. Its name became famous. Great fame was his.

examples.pie: bʰṓr séneh₂s dʰwórm̥ nékʷti gʷémt. h₁íh₂ h₁ím ḱléwt. HréwdHt. pótey sth₂dʰí. gʷéru bʰére. dáyh₂weres gʷm̥té. bʰṓr h₂epó drémt. séneh₂ gʷḗn múHs-kʷe h₂én tḱitā́m.
examples.en: A thief came by night to an old woman's door. She heard him. She cried aloud: "Husband, stand up!" "Bring the spear!" "Brothers-in-law, come!" The thief ran away. There lived the old woman and a mouse.

examples.pie: h₁ésti sth₂dʰlóm h₁itóm.
examples.en: The place is passable.

examples.pie: h₂éwsos píḱta diwés dʰúgh₂ter lukdʰí. h₁yéh₂ méǵh₂ h₁régʷos h₂epó ǵʰéys. gʷṓs h₂éǵrom gʷowsth₂ṓd h₁éǵʰs wédʰe. gʷíh₃woyh₁ent polh₁éwes h₁sih₁ént. widóyh₁ent te sóh₂wl̥-kʷe te sékʷetor.
examples.en: Dawn, adorned daughter of Sky, shine! You who drive away the great darkness! Lead the cattle out of the cow-stall to the pasture. May they live, may they be many. May they see you, and behind you the sun follows.

examples.pie: gʰórdʰe moy gʷṓs kʷsépi ph₂sdʰí. ḱwónes h₁régʷesi bʰéwdʰete. gʷʰéntōr-kʷe stóygʰom mē widóyh₁t. h₁ésyo-kʷe h₁éḱwos h₁ím Hih₁kyéh₁t. pérkʷune h₁ím h₂ḱm̥néh₁ kl̥h₂dʰí. gʷówes moy gʷowsth₂óm wékʷsperoy gʷm̥yóyh₁ent.
examples.en: Fence, guard my cattle at night. Dogs, be awake in the darkness. And may the slayer not find the path. And may his horse throw him. Perkunos, strike him with a stone. May my cows come to the stall in the evening.

examples.pie: ǵʰwḗr h₂éwibʰos h₂epó ih₂dʰí. h₁íh₂n̥s mē h₁éps moysóm mē lémbʰs. ḱóymom gʰórtom mē gʷéms gʷowsth₂óm-wē mē gʷéms. dedórḱh₂e-ge te nu me ne dedórḱth₂e. sh₂itós h₁sdʰí nu sélos ih₂dʰí. h₁éy-kʷe h₁régʷos h₂epó bʰugyéh₁t.
examples.en: Wild beast, go away from the sheep! Do not seize them, do not seize the ram. Do not come to the homely enclosure or to the cow-stall. I have seen you indeed; now you do not see me. Be bound! Now go to the marsh. And may he flee away into the darkness!

examples.pie: kúdʰe swéḱruh₂ sédoh₂? snúse h₂Hséh₂i h₁idʰé sísde. nu toy ḱós dṓm sédos. kʷíd h₂éyeri dʰédʰeh₁oh₂? gʷṓs h₂ml̥ǵdʰí dʰoHnéh₂m-kʷe méǵʰye ḱóm pékʷe. tód mówdoh₁ dʰédʰeh₁oh₂.
examples.en: Mother-in-law, where shall I sit? Daughter-in-law, sit here at the hearth. Now this house is your dwelling. What shall I do in the morning? Milk the cows, and bake grain with me. I will do it with joy.

examples.pie: nu moy bʰréh₂tēr dayh₂wérm̥ gʷʰént. kʷésmey h₁eǵóh₂ luǵréh₂ HréwdHoh₂? nu moy sweḱrúh₂ h₁mé h₃eh₃óde. ǵl̥h₂ṓws-ge moy th₂kéh₁yeti. téḱneh₂ moy méne bʰréh₂term̥ h₃eh₃óde. kŕ̥sna-ge me kʷsép nu h₁m̥dʰí.
examples.en: Now my brother has killed my husband's brother. For whom shall I, a wretched woman, weep? Now my mother-in-law hates me. My husband's sister is silent. My children hate my brother. Black night, take me now.

examples.pie: kúdʰe swéḱruh₂ sésoh₂? néwoy démi méne suHnúh₁ ḱóm sésesi. h₁ím lubʰyési? h₁ím lubʰyóh₂. dʰwṓr péh₂ureh₂. sríHgos péh₂ureh₂m dʰwórm̥ pér ne gʷm̥sḱéti. nu légʰesey h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m téksoh₂. túH moy h₁uséwih₂ snusós.
examples.en: Mother-in-law, where shall I sleep? You will sleep with my son in the new house. Do you like it? I like it. The door is small. The cold does not come in through a small door. Then I will weave wool for the bed. You are a good daughter-in-law to me.

examples.pie: h₂wést. kʷyéh₁s? kʷyéh₁m̥ ḱḗr-kʷe moy méwdeti. nu swóns h₁éḱwons dṓm h₁élh₂oh₂. m̥néh₁ye h₁ddʰí-kʷe.
examples.en: It has dawned. Did you rest? I rested, and my heart is glad. Now I will drive my horses home. Stay and eat!

examples.pie: h₁yód gʰósteyes h₂ḱh₃ént mr̥tóybʰos loypéh₂m sikʷdʰí. tóns kh₂n̥ménh₁ gʷr̥nHdʰí. gʷoh₂móm linkʷdʰí ḱóymom h₁idʰí méwde-kʷe.
examples.en: When the guests have eaten, pour out the remainder for the dead. Praise them with a song. Leave the altar, go home, and rejoice.

examples.pie: nu nos ń̥mr̥tōs déywōs dh₂pnóm gʷm̥té. sédesh₂ str̥h₃mé sweh₂dú médʰu ǵʰumé. sdté ǵéwsete méwdete-kʷe. h₁yós wos ǵʰéwdeti tósmey h₁wésuh₂ dh₃té.
examples.en: Now come, immortal gods, to our feast! We have spread the seats, we have poured the sweet mead. Sit down, taste, and rejoice! Whoever pours for you, to him give good things.

examples.pie: h₂élbʰit h₂wékst. h₁íd h₂éyeri témh₁omes? h₁íd h₂éyeri ne témh₁omes. h₂éḱesh₂ éti ne h₂susyéti. h₁yód h₂wérseti ǵr̥h₂nóm púHyēti. dyḗws nos sóh₂wl̥ dh₃yéh₁t.
examples.en: The barley has grown. Shall we cut it tomorrow? We will not cut it tomorrow. The ears are still not dry. If it rains, the grain will rot. May Sky give us sun!

examples.pie: kʷíd toy h₁óh₃s h₃édeti? wósh₂r̥ bʰésm̥. ḱósyeh₂i nékʷti méǵʰye ḱóm mē légʰs. nu ḱwn̥bʰís ḱóm sésmi. twéd h₂epó bʰéwgonti. wósh₂r̥ h₁wésu mórom h₂epó h₂éǵeti. túH ǵn̥h₃rós h₁óh₃s toy púHyeti.
examples.en: Why does your mouth smell? I chewed garlic. Do not lie down beside me tonight! Then I will sleep with the dogs. They will flee from you! Garlic is good; it drives away plague. You are wise, but your mouth stinks.

examples.pie: wĺ̥kʷos-ge toy h₂ówins widóyh₁t. nu-kʷe toy h₂éǵrōs tr̥sih₁ént. médʰu-ge toy kréwh₂s bʰuHyéh₁t. HeHḱéwes-ge toy h₁éḱwōs twéd bʰugih₁ént. gʷéwōm-ge toy h₂mélǵos púHyoyh₁t. h₃nóbʰis-ge toy h₂egʰéh₂ uḱyéh₁t.
examples.en: May the wolf find your sheep. And then may your fields dry up. May your mead become blood. May your swift horses flee from you. May the milk of your cows rot. May kin wish you evil things.

examples.en: What are your sons doing? The boys are leading the foals around the house. My young daughter laughs. My sons laugh.

examples.pie: h₃ésth₁ dn̥ǵʰwéh₂i ne h₁ésti h₁íh₂-kʷe h₃ésth₁h₂ Hrunépti. mógʰew h₁íh₂m̥ ph₂sdʰí. h₁yód h₁éǵʰs h₁éyti tód kʷis wékʷos ne kapyéti.
examples.en: In the tongue there is no bone, and it breaks bones. Guard it, young man. The word that goes out, no one seizes.

examples.pie: mógʰew toy ménos yugdʰí. wiHrósyo ménos HeHḱús h₁éḱwos. ń̥yugom ménos stóygʰōd h₃sléydʰt. h₁yós swóm ménos yéwgt só swóm dṓm h₁r̥sḱéti.
examples.en: Young man, yoke your mind. The mind of a man is a swift horse. An unyoked mind slips from the path. He who yokes his mind arrives at his own home.
